name: git_uncommitted_changes
description: List the workspace's uncommitted changes — staged, unstaged, and untracked files — as a name-status list by default, one line per changed path, or as the full unified diff — with the contents of untracked files — when includeDiff is true. Pass paths to limit the result to specific workspace-relative files or directories. If the workspace is not a git repository, it reports that plainly rather than failing. Read-only.

detailed: Lists the workspace's uncommitted changes, as a name-status list or a full diff.

whimsical: {source} is sweeping up the uncommitted work
{source} is checking what is still unsaved

detailed: tool {participantRole} is computing the uncommitted changes

paths.description: Optional list of workspace-relative file or directory paths to limit the result to. If omitted, the whole repository is considered.

includeDiff.description: Optional. When true, return the full unified diff instead of the name-status list; when false (the default), only the name-status list is returned.

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional timeout in seconds. Capped by the executor default tool timeout; a value above the cap is clamped to the cap.
